recommendation: Promote-candidate: acquire-v4. It attacks exactly what poisons sessions — wrong locks 17 -> 7 overall, contested wrong-lock rate .361 -> .167 (beyond the >=15pp bar wave-a set), false gestures 2 -> 1, correct case end-states 37 -> 44 — while paying 3 recoverable non-locks (lockRate .944) and a slower p90 (4.7s, honest-ambiguity tail). If the commander weighs lockRate 1.0 or minimal Swift diff heavily, sustained-ambiguity is the conservative fallback: it strictly dominates shipped on every aggregate (42/54 correct, 12 wrong, 0 false gestures, 400ms median, .602 on-target, zero non-locks) and only touches ambiguity resolution. D-027-STYLE GATE for acquire-v4 (all on dev n=54 unless stated): (1) wrongLocks <= 10 [measured 7]; (2) contested wrong-lock rate <= .25 [.167]; (3) correct locks >= shipped's 37 [44]; (4) false gesture locks <= 2 [1]; (5) non-locks <= 4 [3]; (6) median latency <= 600ms [410]; (7) mean on-target >= .55 [.585]; (8) shipped/legacy replay regression suite green [green]; (9) ONE-SHOT locked_test n=5 by the commander at promotion time only: zero wrong locks (shipped has 0 there), >=4/5 locks, on-target >= shipped-0.05 — n=5 cannot support finer claims; (10) live Swift port must instrument tap-to-occupant distance for one release BEFORE hard-coding centeredRadius=0.05, because the bench tap point is idealized (truth's first-detection torso mean).
risks: centeredRadius transfers from an idealized tap point: bench regions are seeded from the true target's own first-detected torso; real user taps are sloppier, which could push legitimate targets outside 0.05 and lengthen latency (mitigation in gate item 10; sensitivity shows 0.04-0.07 all beat shipped).

n=54 dev, contested n=36 (~±13pp CI): v4's -10 wrong locks is beyond noise, but bucket-level counts (e.g. 3 residual instant-wrongs) are single-case granularity; keep growing verified gold (230 dev proposals remain) before the one-shot.

Latency tail is real UX: p90 4.7s / max 6.9s in contested scenes (was 3.0s/5.2s); the product must show waiting/raise-paddle affordances during honest ambiguity or users will re-tap into the patience window.

1 measured correct->wrong regression (ta-960a1a200d6d-s0w2-p1: gate defers a correct instant lock, later dominance picks the wrong occupant at 4.5s) and 1 correct->never_locked (ta-b6f280b2900c-s0w2-p12, off-center loner, recoverable).

2 residual wrong locks are provably unwinnable by any occupancy-geometry rule (bystander exactly on the tapped point; truth first pose-detected after the 6s last resort) — further gains need appearance/re-id evidence, not threshold tuning.
